profile.ja:
魔のものに対抗するため、科学の粋を集めて強化された存在。
タイプヒーローというコードネームで呼ばれていた。
特別兵装として、シンイとカムイという装備を持つ。
シンイは特殊な粒子により作られたブレード、カムイは常時展開可能なシールドである。
兵装の負荷に耐えられるよう遺伝子操作も行われており、常人の数倍の身体能力を誇る。
感情表現には乏しく、常に冷静、人に仇なす存在を駆逐するマシーンと化していたが、時折子供っぽい動作や仕草をみせることがあり、それが本来の性格であると伺い知ることができる。
現在は水城家の居候として幸せに暮らしている。
profile.en: They are an existence enhanced with the essence of science to counter demonic forces. They were known by the codename Type Hero. They possess special equipment, Shin'i and Kamui. Shin'i is a blade made from special particles, and Kamui is a shield that can be deployed at any time. They have undergone genetic modification to withstand the load of their equipment, boasting physical abilities several times that of a normal person. They are often calm and lack emotional expression, having become a machine dedicated to eliminating forces that harm people. However, they occasionally display childish actions and behaviors, which may be a glimpse into their true personality. Currently, they live with the Mizuki family, where they are happy.

text.ja: この服どう……？　わたしは可愛くて気に入ってる……特に気に入ってるのはこの蛇と蝶……見て、すっごく可愛いでしょ……？
text.en: What do you think of this outfit? I think it's cute and I like it... especially the snake and butterfly patterns... look, they're really cute, right?

text.ja: 着物は戦いにくいけど……かわいいって言われる方が大事だから大丈夫……慣れればいいだけだから
text.en: Kimonos are hard to fight in... but being told they're cute is more important, so it's okay. I just need to get used to it.

text.ja: 着物を自分で着られるのってすごいんだって……ちゃんと一人で着られるわたしはえらい？
text.en: Being able to wear a kimono by myself is a big deal, right? I'm proud of myself for being able to do it.

text.ja: 忍術ごっこ、ふうまにもみて貰いたい。白蛇も蝶もわたしも、ふうまのためにがんばるから今度見に来て？
text.en: I want Fuuma to see my ninja training. The white snake, the butterfly, and I will all do our best for Fuuma, so come and see us next time.

text.ja: 着物、もっと見たいの？　いいよ、好きなだけ見て？　ふうまにみて貰えて……わたしも嬉しいから……♪
text.en: You want to see more of my kimono? It's okay, you can look as much as you want. It makes me happy when Fuuma looks at me...♪

text.ja: 激しい動きをすると着物がはだけるの……あ、ふうま……いまヘンなこと考えてるときの顔になってたよ……
text.en: When I move around a lot, my kimono comes undone... ah, Fuuma, you had a weird expression on your face just now...

text.ja: どうかな、着物かわいい……？　ふうまが気に入ったなら……これからずっと着物でもいいよ？
text.en: Do you think my kimono is cute? If Fuuma likes it, I'll wear it all the time from now on.

text.ja: 帯がふりふりのリボンみたいで可愛いの。ふうまもこういうのすき？　可愛いって思ってくれてる？
text.en: The sash is like a fluffy ribbon, and it's cute. Do you like this kind of thing, Fuuma? Do you think it's cute?
